OAT-03/S09.detail: Needs Haiku to hang to its 20 s attempt deadline. No seam on main; built a network-level one instead of a code change: bedrock-proxy.mjs (AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME on the private backend only; Haiku requests hang or get a 429 after N ms, Mistral is re-signed and forwarded; per-request log for the Haiku second-try count, Q4). Self-tested offline: 429 after 600 ms, and a hang held until the client aborted. Pointing the backend at it needs `convex env set` (same gate as S07). ask-ai-fault.ts S09 checks providerMs >= 20000 and durationMs - providerMs <= ~2 s per row and flags > 30 s. Context now built exactly as AskModal.tsx (temporal line folded in), as for S07.
